source.tableSelection: User confirmed only jkxt belongs to SC2.

notes: 日志覆盖2020年1月22日至2020年5月2日；最终存档保存于2020年7月30日，其间88.9天没有对应行为记录。
游戏时长根据相邻行为不超过30分钟的活跃片段估算，缺少完整登录、退出和闲置记录。
玩家路线根据操作位置推算；方块朝向等状态及未记录的建筑采用最终存档补足。
聊天、命令、手机号、密码、邮箱和IP等原文不进入公开数据。
未记载的人工构件按邻近施工和交互记录推断出现时间；没有时点证据的构件在日志截止至最终存档之间分阶段补齐。天然地形和无施工证据的生成结构保留为基底。

reconstruction.timeEstimate: All session durations are estimates based on observed actions; login, logout and idle movement are unavailable.
reconstruction.anchors: Action coordinates are targets or interaction locations, not recorded continuous player positions.
reconstruction.blockStates: The source records block names only. States and unlogged changes use final-map repair.
reconstruction.duplicates: Exact repeated source fields share one event; sourceRows and duplicateRows retain original record counts.

method.source: Only lmzapi.jkxt gameplay and final SVR2 voxels; source actions and durations are unchanged.
method.naturalBaseline: Natural-looking materials and generated structural materials without local construction evidence are retained.
method.initial: Unrecorded manufactured blocks and evidenced first-break artificial predecessors begin as air.
method.nearby: Same-material placement within 32 blocks is preferred; observed interactions bound existence time.
method.constructionEvidence: Structural material needs >=8 architectural placements or >=3 strong manufactured placements in neighbouring 16-cube cells.
method.late: Connected components without construction timing appear bottom-up in a shared 30-minute to 24-hour window within the 88.9-day log-to-map gap.
method.constraints: Factual actions always win. Integer-second inferred patches never coincide with a factual edit at the same voxel.
method.connectedConstruction: Six-neighbour connected 16-cube initial cells share one build window, including across 64-block region boundaries. Nearby-evidence times remain fixed; unknown late members inherit a connected construction window or appear bottom-up within one late day.
method.naturalAttachments: Only detached components with actual planting, a logged multi-block artificial supporting plane, or dimension-atypical construction evidence are delayed. Persistent decorative leaves and horizontal beams require matching adjacent placements and crafted enclosure. High water requires an exact artificial floor and multiple walls. Ground-connected natural terrain, sea water and ocean-floor bubbles are preserved. All inferred creation precedes the first located real action; unknown cropped chunks remain untouched.
